recommendation.primary: Request latest dated CAPMAS food-price bulletin plus machine-readable commodity/unit/region series and explicit commercial redistribution/collection terms from the published customer-service contact. Review a real dated bulletin before ingesting aggregate estimates.
recommendation.retail: Request a licensed product/store/pack/offer feed from Carrefour Egypt; public page visibility grants no bulk API rights. Use user-confirmed purchase records for exact local amounts while provider permission is unresolved.
recommendation.produce: Ask Obour/Economic Affairs Sector for dated wholesale and representative retail files with unit definitions and reuse terms; keep wholesale ranges separate from retail estimates.
recommendation.implementationNext: Use explicit source kind, country/currency, immutable observed date versus price period, pack/unit, location/store, offer validity and missing fields. User price overrides retain precedence. No national average from this sample.
recommendation.initiative: Keep MSIT announced initiative packs as a separate dated offer bank. Prices start 2026-09-25 at participating outlets; current stock/end date unknown. Clarify reuse before bulk distribution; never use as unrestricted national averages.
